decision_question: Does replacing the plug-in one-hour volatility with a conservative maximum of the existing floor, one-hour realized volatility, and the engine's existing causal fast volatility reduce short-horizon probability overconfidence without fitting a new coefficient?

motivation.measured_failure: The retained strategy's internal fair probability is more overconfident and less calibrated than the executable market, while simple calibration, sizing, filters, delayed entry, exits, order flow, cross-venue paths, and derivatives features have already failed their causal gates.
motivation.structural_rationale: A one-hour estimator can lag an abrupt volatility increase. The engine already maintains a causal 15-minute-half-life EWMA variance for signal normalization. Taking the maximum can only retain or widen the remaining-price distribution; it never makes the model more confident than the current volatility input.
motivation.scope: Probability-model research only. This registration does not authorize a strategy variant, exact replay, paper trading, live trading, or use of the active binary-complement block.

frozen_formula.fast_variance_update: alpha = 1 - exp(-delta_seconds / tau_seconds); variance = (1 - alpha) * prior_variance + alpha * log_return_squared / delta_seconds

public_data_contract.source: Official Binance public BTCUSDT spot one-second kline daily archives and adjacent SHA-256 checksum files
excluded_known_strategy_windows: all active or sealed forward-block conditions
public_data_contract.five_minute_window_alignment: UTC Unix timestamps divisible by 300 seconds
public_data_contract.strike: open price of the first one-second Binance kline in the five-minute window
public_data_contract.causal_spot: close price of the one-second kline ending at or before the registered decision offset
public_data_contract.terminal_label: last one-second close before the five-minute boundary is greater than the registered strike; exact ties are excluded

frozen_estimands.primary_grain: one forecast per five-minute condition and registered decision offset
secondary_metrics: fraction of rows where candidate volatility exceeds baseline
Brier and log loss for baseline probabilities at least 0.75 or at most 0.25
frozen_estimands.uncertainty: Paired block bootstrap by UTC day with 10000 deterministic resamples and seed 20260721
frozen_estimands.comparison_sign: positive baseline-minus-candidate proper-score deltas favor the candidate

decision_rules.pass: Register one default-off opportunity-capture field and require an independent Polymarket opportunity-level screen before any exact strategy replay or runtime implementation.
decision_rules.fail: Reject fast_volatility_max_v1 and do not tune the half-life, floor, maximum operator, decision offsets, or score thresholds on these windows.
decision_rules.inconclusive: Treat missing or invalid public data as a failed research screen; do not substitute the active forward block or lower a gate.
